description: Cross-implementation PSBT signing vector. The Java ME signer produces signature_der_sighash and signed_psbt; the Rust companion must recompute the same sighash, verify the signature, and finalize signed_psbt into a valid transaction.
mnemonic: abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon about

notes.prev_tx_description: Coinbase-like funding transaction (version 2, scriptSig 5151) paying 200000 sats to the P2WPKH script of m/84'/0'/0'/0/0. Included in the PSBT as non_witness_utxo so the signer can verify the input amount.
notes.tx_description: Version 2, 1 input spending prev_txid:0 with nSequence 0xfffffffd (opt-in RBF), 1 output sending 100000 sats to bc1qcr8te4kr609gcawutmrza0j4xv80jy8z306fyu, nLockTime 800000. Fee 100000 sats.
notes.sighash_type: SIGHASH_ALL (0x01); the signer refuses any other type
notes.signature_scheme: ECDSA secp256k1 with RFC 6979 deterministic k, low-S enforced (BIP 62/146)
notes.psbt_input_fields: non_witness_utxo (0x00) + witness_utxo (0x01); signed_psbt adds partial_sig (0x02). The signer never emits final_script_witness; the companion finalizes.
